provenance.structure: spinner.tsx: a single lucide-react Loader2Icon, no wrapper div, no track, no gradient
provenance.color: no dedicated color slot — arc renders in currentColor (inherited ambient text color); changed only by applying a text-* utility class in context, per the docs' own spinner-color.tsx example
provenance.stroke-width: not independently controllable — baked into the Loader2Icon glyph path
provenance.size: size-4 (1rem = 16px) via className, the only size any example/doc renders by default; size-3/6/8 appear only in the docs' spinner-size.tsx demo, not a component prop
provenance.label: spinner.tsx: aria-label="Loading" (hardcoded, not a prop)
provenance.duration: Tailwind's built-in animate-spin utility class (1s linear infinite) — app/globals.css grepped, no project override found

behavior.repeat-announce.note: no re-announcement logic — static label only

prop.size.note: not a discrete prop — arbitrary className (size-3/4/6/8 Tailwind utilities), continuous, not expressible as a skeleton enum

style.root.size.source: size-4 (default, and the only size shipped without an ad-hoc className override)

style.arc.stroke-width.note: REGISTRY RENDERING APPROXIMATION, not a shadcn-sourced number — Loader2Icon's stroke is part of the fixed glyph path, not an independent CSS-controllable dimension in the real component (declared expressibility gap)

style.arc.radius.note: derived: (16px size - 2px approximated stroke-width) / 2 — inherits the same approximation caveat as stroke-width above

style.arc.color.source: no stroke/color override in spinner.tsx — the Loader2Icon glyph inherits ambient text color

style.root.duration.source: Tailwind's default animate-spin keyframe duration, unmodified in this repo
